verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs say Sai works across the entire operating system, covering desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals, using UI, keyboard and mouse. The Agent-S repo describes clicking, typing and scrolling in ordinary desktop and web apps, and Sai runs on cloud Windows/Linux machines or the user's own Mac/Windows device. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of keyboard-shortcut handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of OS-wide control (all evidence is first-party).
